lines.text: Many learners say: My mansion is small.
A mansion is a very big house.
Apartment! I rent a small apartment.

data.why: A mansion is a very big house.

quiz.stem: I rent a small ___ near the station.

native.hook: 「マンション」は英語で通じない
native.tip: 英語の mansion は大豪邸。日本のマンションは apartment と言います。
native.caption: “My mansion is small.”と言っていませんか？😅 英語の mansion は「大豪邸」のこと。日本でいうマンションは apartment（または condo）です。 “My apartment is small.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“apartment”。mansion は大豪邸のこと。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: A mansion is a huge house. Use apartment for a Japanese manshon.
en.caption: Do you say “My mansion is small.”? 😅 In English a mansion is a huge house. A Japanese manshon is an apartment. The natural way is “My apartment is small.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
